parties: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited (seller) and SML Mahindra Limited (buyer, listed subsidiary)
headline: Mahindra & Mahindra transfers Trucks & Buses Division to listed subsidiary SML Mahindra in a ₹525 crore slump sale, consolidating group's >3.5T commercial vehicle business
sum: M&M to sell its Truck & Bus Division to SML Mahindra—its 58.97%-owned listed subsidiary (acquired from Sumitomo/Isuzu in Aug 2025)—for ₹525 crore as a going-concern slump sale. The transaction, subject to working capital adjustments and regulatory approvals, is expected to close by 31 Jan 2027 and follows M&M's August 2025 acquisition of controlling stake in SML Isuzu (now SML Mahindra), creating a unified commercial vehicle platform spanning light, intermediate and heavy trucks and buses in the >3.5T segment.
implication: Slump sale of a division that is not separately undertaking-classified (per SEBI LODR Regulation 37A inapplicability) structured via Business Transfer Agreement rather than Scheme of Arrangement—permitting faster execution while triggering related-party disclosure and arm's-length valuation requirements; contract manufacturing continuity arrangement preserves operational leverage post-transfer.
detail: M&M's Truck & Bus Division generated ₹2,989 crore in revenue (FY26), representing ~2% of M&M's total operational income and ₹481 crore of net worth (0.65%). The division sold 14,832 vehicles in FY26. Transfer includes employees, assets, IP, licences, permits, insurance, contracts, rights and liabilities as a going concern. Business Transfer Agreement to be executed on or before 7 Aug 2026; transaction completion by 31 Jan 2027 subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. M&M will continue manufacturing Mahindra-branded vehicles under a contract manufacturing arrangement post-transfer. Deal classified as related-party transaction at arm's length; valuation independently assessed by GT Valuation Advisors (₹525 cr consideration) and BDO Valuation Advisory.

framework.note: Sale of undertaking requires Board and shareholder approval by special resolution; transfers ≥20% of net worth or income trigger this provision
Related-party transaction approval required from independent directors and arm's length declaration mandatory for inter-group transfers
Scheme of Arrangement not required as MTBD does not qualify as separately-registered 'undertaking' under the SEBI definition; slump sale via BTA permissible
No Objection Certificate from tax authorities required 30 days prior to transfer; mandatory conditions precedent for slump sales

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulation 2011
framework.note: Mandatory open offer triggered by M&M's prior acquisition of 58.96% stake in SML in Aug 2025; applicable to this transfer as a control-consolidation event
Contractual structure for slump sale on going-concern basis; specifies consideration, conditions precedent, working capital adjustments, representation & warranties, and closing mechanics
Cost of acquisition for capital gains / losses on disposal of business undertaking; valuation of transferred assets per Section 45(5A)

framework.ref: Competition Commission of India Act 2023, Section 5(a)
framework.note: Related-party intra-group transfers may be de minimis; CCI clearance not anticipated but fair trading analysis advisable given consolidation

approvals: Board of Directors of M&M (29 Jul 2026)
Board of Directors of SML Mahindra (29 Jul 2026)

structure.novel: Slump sale of division leveraging exemption from Regulation 37A (Scheme of Arrangement not required as MTBD does not meet standalone 'undertaking' classification)—accelerates deal timeline vs. Scheme route. Contract manufacturing arrangement post-closing preserves operational continuity and manufacturing leverage for transferred entity. Arm's-length independent valuation by two advisors (GT Valuation Advisors, BDO Valuation Advisory) for related-party pricing audit trail.

triggers.note: Slump sale of business division representing ~2% of M&M's revenue and 0.65% of net worth triggers undertaking-disposal threshold
Related-party transaction under M&M promoter ownership of SML (58.96% stake); independent director approval + arm's length certification required
Tax closure / NOC required 30 days pre-transfer to avoid tax authority objection post-closure
SML already under M&M control post-Aug 2025 acquisition; consolidation of CV business under common promoter may warrant CCI review under merger norms
